digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and ticket event compaction
propositions: rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log silently drops event history that exists only in a prior SNAPSHOT when compaction pre-dating 2026-07-07 deleted folded source events, causing 214 tickets to regress from closed to open/in_progress
fsck --repair-snapshots with --dry-run mutates the store instead of performing a read-only preview because the code path ignores dry_run parameter
a snapshot rebuild must fail closed if its prior SNAPSHOT cites source_event_uuids with no corresponding file on disk rather than replaying an incomplete log and losing data
deleted event files must be restored from git history as .retired sources to complete the log before rebuild, making it auto-repairable for tickets in the latent population
restore_deleted_sources must use newest-deletion-wins semantics and sweep full ticket deletion history, not only the newest snapshot's cited deletions
